text: いろんな　トレーナーに　しょうぶを　いどんだ　ものじゃ　いまでは　しょうぶを　みながら　むかしを　おもいだすの　だけが　たのしみ　なのじゃ

structure.jp: いろんな　トレーナーに
しょうぶを　いどんだ　ものじゃ
structure.en: I used to throw down challenges to battle

structure.jp: しょうぶを　みながら
むかしを　おもいだすの　だけが
たのしみ　なのじゃ

patterns.name: 〜たものだ
patterns.span: いどんだ　ものじゃ
patterns.explanation: A past verb plus ものだ looks back fondly on something you often did long ago. じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. いどんだ　ものじゃ = 'I used to challenge them'.

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら on a verb says two things happen at the same time. しょうぶを　みながら = 'while watching battles'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. むかしを　おもいだすの = 'remembering the old days'.
